sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Anti Tarnish Pink tulip Leaf CZ Bracelet
sourceNotes.rawContent: Wear a little garden on your wrist — this charming bracelet features delicate pink tulip charms with sparkling green CZ leaves set on a dainty gold chain with gold bead accents. Feminine, fresh, and forever in style. Anti-tarnish finish with adjustable fit
